title: 努努和威朗普·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 红蓝冬衣与毛边帽保留孩童形象，白毛蓝脸伙伴有四条独立手臂。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Nunu is a human boy in a fully covering red-and-blue winter coat, mittens, boots, and a fur-edged cap. Willump is his much larger white-furred yeti companion with a blue face, rounded horns, and four anatomically distinct arms; preserve their child-and-guardian size relationship and species differences.
art_direction.scene: Small child Nunu in full red-and-blue winter clothing stands beside the much larger white yeti Willump. Show exactly FOUR distinct yeti arms clearly connected to the torso, hands resting peacefully at different levels. Their friendly confident paired silhouette dominates luminous ice-blue and warm-white paper with coral and turquoise accents. No additional beings.
art_direction.palette: ice blue, white, indigo, scarf red, aurora green; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
